title: The blueprint should lead a transcript through recorded stages to minutes with provenance (2026-11-27)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Then I want you to look at something that has not been tested since we created SRS.

The SRS blueprint was designed to lead us through a structured process for creating minutes with provenance.

Look through the lth works working group and hexium data for real information.

An srs based minutes file should follow a blueprint.

When we take a transcript, there should be a set of stages that are recorded within a SRS minutes document.

Something like:

First identify topics
Then slice the transcript into fragments and link them to the topics.
Identify attendees if possible, bring in roles if we know them
Identify potential decision points, link all relevant snippets.
Categorise different parts of the discussion... Record, discussion, decision prep
Identify unambiguous decisions and create an internal decision record
Identify tasks and follow up actions, create a task list
Add reports and references as attachments
Generate a set of compositions for minutes, decision log, tasks,

Your goal is to use the real data and create a srs minutes example. See how far a blueprint can go. Prototype tooling for the complete process and then work out what SRS is missing.

I should be able to distribute an srs minutes package that allows this process to be repeated
